remarks: Palmer Hill Townhouse! in this luxury gated community located on the Old Greenwich/Stamford border. Fantastic, light and bright, 3 bedroom/2.5 bath townhouse model, rarely on market! 1 car attached garage + 1 deeded parking space in the midrise garage. Many home updates and remodeling. Flexible floor plan. Features include all wood floors, customized cabinetry in the eat in kitchen, SS appliances, 2 pantries, open plan living/dining room with a gas fireplace, tray ceiling, custom lighting throughout, French doors to a Juliet balcony in the living/dining room, and French doors to a private patio on the 1st level. There is a powder room with a heated floor on the main level. Upper level has 2 bedrooms, new wood floors, custom closets and a newly remodeled full bath. The 1st level has the 3rd en-suite bedroom with full bath, custom closets, and French doors to your Private Patio. This room has the flexibility to be a home office ( as in photos)/den/playroom. Amenities include a clubhouse, pool, hot tub, fire pit, gym with yoga room above, and business center. Dog Friendly! Minutes to Metro North and I-95. DON'T MISS THIS FABULOUS TOWNHOUSE! Great Price, Great Home! Great Opportunity!
